changes.text: 先看水从哪里来。1832年到1849年间，伦敦的供水变动很多：南华克公司与南伦敦公司合并，成立南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司；伦敦桥的水厂被撤除，合并后的公司改从沃克斯霍尔桥上游约半英里、巴特西原野一带的泰晤士河取水；兰贝斯公司则一直在亨格福德市场对面取水。

Start with where the water came from. Between 1832 and 1849 London's supply changed a good deal. The Southwark Water Company merged with the South London Water Company to form the Southwark and Vauxhall Company; the works at London Bridge were abolished, and the new company drew from the Thames at Battersea Fields, about half a mile above Vauxhall Bridge. The Lambeth Company went on taking its water opposite Hungerford Market.

在斯诺看来，这个格局再理想不过。两家公司都给富人也给穷人供水，大房子小房子都有；他断言，接这家水和接那家水的人，在房屋、人口和周围的一切物质条件上都没有任何差别，因此想不出比这更能彻底检验供水作用的实验——它是环境“现成摆在观察者面前”的。规模也大得惊人：不少于三十万人，不分男女老幼、职业身份，从体面人家到赤贫者，在没有选择、多数也不知情的情况下分成了两组：一组的水里有伦敦的污水，以及可能来自霍乱病人的任何东西；另一组的水没有这类污物。

To Snow the arrangement could hardly have been better. "Each Company supplies both rich and poor, both large houses and small", he wrote, and since there was "no difference whatever" in the houses, the people or their physical surroundings, no experiment could have been devised that would more thoroughly test the effect of water supply on cholera "than this, which circumstances placed ready made before the observer." It was enormous, too: "No fewer than three hundred thousand people of both Sexes, of every age and occupation, and of every rank and station, from gentlefolks down to the very poor, were divided into two groups without their choice, and, in most cases, without their knowledge" — one group drinking water that carried the sewage of London and whatever might have come from cholera patients, the other water free of it.
1854年，他从一份名单入手。他向登记总署申请，拿到了两家公司混供地区霍乱死者的住址：一部分刊登在每周公报上，另一些获准抄录。8月中旬，他先查兰贝斯的两个分区——肯宁顿第一区和第二区。到8月12日，这两个分区共死亡44人；他查出其中38户由南华克和沃克斯霍尔公司供水，4户由兰贝斯公司供水，另有2户用自家院里的水井，不接任何一家公司的水。

In 1854 he started from a list. He asked the General Register Office for the addresses of people who had died of cholera in the districts where the two supplies were intermingled; some had been printed in the Weekly Returns, and he was allowed to copy others. About the middle of August he began with two sub-districts of Lambeth, Kennington first part and Kennington second part. There had been 44 deaths there down to 12 August. Of the houses where they occurred, he found 38 supplied by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company, 4 by the Lambeth Company, and 2 with pump-wells on the premises and no company supply at all.
他一弄清这些数字，就告诉了法尔医生（Dr. Farr）。斯诺记下法尔对结果“深受触动”，并在法尔的建议下，伦敦南部各区的登记员被要求在每一例霍乱死亡中登记发病所在房屋的供水。这项规定定于8月26日以后才实行，所以斯诺决定把自己的调查一直做到这一天，好让整场疫情的事实都有据可查。

As soon as he had these particulars he passed them to Dr Farr, who, Snow wrote, "was much struck with the result". At Farr's suggestion the registrars of all the south districts of London were asked to return the water supply of the house in which the attack took place, in every death from cholera. The order was to take effect only after 26 August, so Snow resolved to carry his own inquiry down to that date, "so that the facts might be ascertained for the whole course of the epidemic."

作者的解读：两组数字方向一致。肯宁顿的38户对4户，来自同一片混供街区；不过肯宁顿的数字只是死亡户数，证据未给出两家在当地各有多少供水户，不能直接当作死亡率比较。表里的315对37，覆盖两家公司的供水户，而伦敦其余地区的59恰好落在两者之间。接兰贝斯水的人家，死亡率比全城其余地方还低；接南华克和沃克斯霍尔水的人家，高出好几倍。如果是街区或空气在起作用，同一片街区里的两组人家不该分得这么开。这层推理是作者补的；斯诺本人的论证集中在供水与死亡的对应上。

The author's reading: the two sets of figures point the same way. Kennington's 38 houses against 4 came from the same intermixed streets, though these are only counts of houses with deaths: the evidence does not say how many houses each company supplied there, so they cannot be compared directly as death rates. The table's 315 against 37 covers the houses each company supplied, with the rest of London's 59 falling between them. Houses on Lambeth water died at a lower rate than the rest of the city, houses on Southwark and Vauxhall water at several times it. If the neighbourhood or the air were doing the killing, two sets of houses in the same streets should not have split so far apart. That step is the author's; Snow's own argument rested on the correspondence between the water and the deaths.
另一种做法（作者设想的替代方案，不是史实）：只比较各区的平均死亡率，或者拿富区和穷区对比。那样贫富、住房、职业都会混进来，水的作用就分不清了。斯诺实际走的是更费事的路——挨家查死者住址、查水、必要时装瓶回家化验——换来的是在同一批街道里比较两种水。

Another approach, and this is the author's counterfactual rather than history, would have been to compare average death rates by district, or rich districts against poor ones. Wealth, housing and occupation would then have crowded in, and the effect of the water would have been hard to separate out. What Snow actually did was more laborious — death addresses, house by house, water carried home in phials — and in return he got a comparison of two waters within the same streets.
还有一点容易被忽略（作者的解读）：斯诺没有等调查全部做完才开口。他在肯宁顿查出头一批数字，就交给了法尔；在法尔的建议下，伦敦南部各区的登记员随后被要求为每一例霍乱死亡填报发病房屋的供水。早期的结果先被用来改进收集证据的办法。

One more point is easy to miss, and it is the author's reading. Snow did not wait for the inquiry to be finished before speaking. Once he had the first figures from Kennington he passed them to Farr, and at Farr's suggestion registrars in the south districts were asked to return the water supply of the house for every cholera death. The early result went first into improving how the evidence was gathered.
必须说清楚：本篇所有数字与叙述都出自斯诺本人的书和表格，本篇的证据里没有当时卫生部门或第三方的独立核查。死者住址来自登记总署，8月26日以后的供水信息按要求应由各区登记员填报；但本篇读到的统计和论证都经斯诺之手整理。提出学说、做调查、整理统计的是同一个人，这不意味着数据有错，但意味着我们读到的是一方的记录。

Plainly: every figure and every account in this piece comes from Snow's own book and his own tables, and the evidence used here contains no independent check by a health authority or anyone else at the time. The addresses of the dead came from the General Register Office, and after 26 August the registrars were asked to return the water supply; but the statistics and the argument we read here were all put together by Snow. When the same man proposes the doctrine, conducts the inquiry and presents the statistics, that does not make the data wrong, but it does mean we are reading one side's record.
其次，“两组人没有任何差别”是斯诺的断言，不是随机分组的结果。哪栋房子接哪家水，由当年的房主或住户决定，并非抽签；这种选择会不会和房租、房龄、地段有关，本篇的证据无法回答，这是作者提出的疑问。斯诺自己的调查也显示，按周交租的工人家庭，水费一律由房东或其代理人缴纳，住户对用哪家公司的水一无所知。作者认为，“选择”往往不在喝水的人手里。

Second, "no difference whatever" between the groups is Snow's assertion, not the product of random assignment. Which company a house took was decided by the owner or occupier, not drawn by lot; whether that choice tracked rents, the age of the houses or their location is a question the evidence here cannot answer, and it is the author's question, not Snow's. His own inquiry shows that for working families on weekly rents the rates were paid by the landlord or his agent, and the residents did not even know which company supplied them. One reading is that the choice was often not in the hands of the people drinking the water.

dispositions.rationale: 中文改为被动语态“伦敦桥的水厂被撤除，合并后的公司改从……取水”，不再把撤除主体定为新公司，与证据和英文一致；英文原样保留。

evidence.quote: The water works at London Bridge were abolished, and the united company derived their supply from the Thames at Battersea Fields

dispositions.rationale: 中英文都恢复“可能”的保留：中文“可能来自霍乱病人的任何东西”，英文“whatever might have come from cholera patients”。

evidence.quote: whatever might have come from the cholera patients

dispositions.rationale: “其余的”/“the rest”收窄为“另一些”/“others”，与证据一致。

evidence.quote: I was kindly permitted to take a copy of others

dispositions.rationale: 英文补上“发病所在房屋”和“霍乱死亡”两个限定：改为“the house in which the attack took place, in every death from cholera”。

evidence.quote: make a return of the water supply of the house in which the attack took place, in all cases of death from cholera

dispositions.rationale: 删去中英文末句未标注的作者概括，因为证据没有记录它成了官方报表中的一栏。同时把规定的生效改为“定于8月26日以后才实行”/“was to take effect”，反映证据中的预定语气。

evidence.quote: This order was to take place after the 26th August

dispositions.rationale: 中英文补充说明：肯宁顿的数字只是死亡户数，证据没有给出两家在当地的供水户数，不能直接当作死亡率比较。

evidence.quote: thirty-eight of the houses in which these deaths occurred were supplied with

dispositions.rationale: 改为“斯诺实际走的是更费事的路”/“What Snow actually did was more laborious”，不再暗示他曾比较并放弃替代方案。

evidence.quote: I resolved to spare no exertion

dispositions.rationale: 删去“登记办法随之改变，此后每一例死亡都要记下供水”。改为伦敦南部各区登记员被要求为每一例霍乱死亡填报发病房屋的供水，不再声称已经实际执行，也不扩大到所有死亡。

evidence.quote: the Registrars of all the south districts of London were requested to make a return of the water supply of the house in which the attack took place, in all cases of death from cholera.

dispositions.rationale: 补充说明住址来自登记总署、8月26日后的供水信息要求由登记员填报，并指出本篇读到的统计和论证经斯诺整理。“编统计”改为“整理统计”。

evidence.quote: to be supplied with the addresses of persons dying of cholera
Some of these addresses were published in the Weekly Returns

dispositions.rationale: 改为水费一律由房东或其代理人缴纳、住户对用哪家公司一无所知，不再说他们不知道水费由谁交。末句在中文标为“作者认为”，英文加“One reading is that”。

evidence.quote: the rates are invariably paid by the landlord or his agent, who often lives at a distance, and the residents know nothing about the matter
